about_the_game:
A Roguelike Farming Adventure Where Every Run Tells a Different Story.

You've been hired by Crossroads Farming Co. to manage their mysterious collection of farmlands suspended at an interdimensional crossroads. Armed with basic tools and a modest budget, you set out to prove yourself worthy of the company. But this won't be any ordinary farming job. The crossroads exists between dimensions, and with it comes unpredictable paranormal phenomena that can transform your entire operation in an instant.

One day you're farming under perfect sunny skies. The next, reality shifts and you're battling desert heat that dries your crops in minutes, or celebrating autumn harvests that mysteriously double your yields. Sometimes the crossroads gifts you with gentle spring rains that water everything automatically. Other times, frost slows growth to a crawl while preserving every drop of precious water. The dimensional instability is both your greatest challenge and your most powerful tool.

Join our development discord!

TWO WAYS TO PROVE YOUR WORTH

RUN MODE - HIGH-STAKES CONTRACTS

Take on challenging farming contracts across procedurally generated farmlands, each with specific objectives to complete. Harvest exact crop quantities, craft particular items, meet profit targets before time runs out, or tackle complex multi-objective challenges. Success earns you Blessings - the company's permanent upgrade currency that makes you a more capable farmer. But failure is real: run out of money, get trapped with no way forward, or miss your objective, and you'll be reassigned to a new farmland to start fresh.

Between contracts, you'll earn powerful upgrade cards that modify how you work. Agriculture cards boost your yields and growth rates. Utility cards enhance your tools and automation. Risk/reward cards offer high-stakes gambles like "Double or Nothing" harvests. Stack these cards as you portal between successful contracts, building increasingly powerful combinations.

HOME FARM MODE - YOUR ENDLESS SANCTUARY

Build your dream farm at your own pace in a persistent farmland that's yours to keep. Experience the full cycle of interdimensional seasons as the crossroads rotates through its patterns every 20 days. Complete rotating objectives for rewards without the pressure of contract failure.

Unlock 20+ permanent milestone bonuses as you progress - bonus harvest chances, plot unlocking discounts, utility radius increases, and faster growth rates. Your home farm auto-saves, letting you return anytime to continue expanding your agricultural empire.

SEVEN DIMENSIONS (+ MORE TO COME)

The crossroads cycles through seven distinct dimensional states, each dramatically changing your strategy:

  • ☀️ Normal - Stable dimensional conditions, perfect for farming

  • 🌧️ Rainy - Constant precipitation waters all crops automatically

  • 🏜️ Desert - Harsh dimensional heat dries crops rapidly

  • 🌸 Spring Bloom - Accelerated growth from spring energy (20% faster)

  • 🍂 Autumn Harvest - Reality bends to double all harvest yields

  • ❄️ Frosty - Slowed growth but water never evaporates

  • 💨 Windy - Dimensional winds grant 50% chance for bonus seeds

MASTER THE FARMING FUNDAMENTALS

Every farmland is procedurally generated with locked plots waiting to be expanded into. Till soil, plant six different crop types, water daily, and harvest when ready. Upgrade your tools to work in 2x2 or 3x3 patterns for efficiency. Deploy automation utilities - sprinklers that water surrounding plots, beehives that double nearby crop yields, composters that spread fertilizer, mechanical tillers that prepare soil automatically, and harvesters that collect crops for you.

Transform your harvests at the crafting station, turning raw crops into valuable goods. Complete tasks from the community board for rewards and experience. Buy seeds and utilities from the shop, but manage your budget carefully - the crossroads doesn't forgive bankruptcy.

CLIMB THE CORPORATE LADDER

Run Mode - Blessings System

  • Spend Blessings earned from successful contracts on permanent upgrades that make you a master farmer:

  • Expand tool coverage to till or water in larger patterns

  • Start each contract with pre-purchased utilities or seed stockpiles

  • Increase utility effectiveness with extended ranges

  • Unlock advanced automation upgrades

Home Farm Mode - Milestone System

Unlock 20+ permanent bonuses by achieving farming milestones:

  • Bonus harvest chances (up to 30% for +1 crop)

  • Adjacent plot watering when using tools (up to 50% chance)

  • Plot unlocking discounts (up to 30% cost reduction)

  • Crop sale bonuses (10% more profit)

  • Ingredient preservation when crafting (10% chance)

  • Growth speed increases (up to 20% faster)

  • Extra task board slots for more opportunities

  • And many more progression-based rewards

LIFE AT THE CROSSROADS

Beautiful toon-shaded 3D graphics with dynamic lighting that shifts based on dimensional phenomena. Gradient skies transition between dimensional states, creating an otherworldly atmosphere. Relaxing music accompanies your work as you build farms suspended in the void between realities. Each farmland tells its own story through procedural generation - no two are ever identical.

FEATURES

  • Two distinct game modes: High-stakes contracts or endless home farm

  • Run Mode: Roguelike structure with permadeath and card-based builds

  • Home Farm Mode: Seasonal cycling, milestone progression, and persistent saves

  • 15+ diverse objective types including speed runs, resource restrictions, and combo challenges

  • 40+ unique upgrade cards to discover and combine (Run Mode)

  • 20+ milestone bonuses for long-term progression (Home Farm Mode)

  • Seven dimensional phenomena that transform gameplay * Procedurally generated farmlands - no two contracts are identical

  • Portal system to chain successful contracts together (Run Mode)

  • Full automation support: sprinklers, beehives, composters, tillers, harvesters * Crafting system with valuable recipe combinations

  • Community task board with rotating objectives

  • Dynamic day/night cycle with 60-second days

  • Keyboard shortcuts for rapid tool switching and camera control

  • Auto-save system for Home Farm Mode

Every contract is a puzzle. Every season brings dimensional change. Every farmland tells a story suspended in the void.

Whether you're chasing promotion through high-stakes contracts or building your forever sanctuary, can you master the crossroads and become Crossroads Farming Co.'s most legendary farmer?

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
